context: Tests whether the agent discovers all three manifest files in the inputs directory, assigns the correct language to each ecosystem, and combines all packages into a single JSON array passed to one CLI check invocation.

checklist.name: Finds all manifests
checklist.description: Scans for all three manifest types: package.json (Node.js), Cargo.toml (Rust), and requirements.txt (Python)

checklist.name: nodejs language
checklist.description: Assigns language `nodejs` to packages from package.json

checklist.name: rust language
checklist.description: Assigns language `rust` to packages from Cargo.toml (not `cargo` or `rs`)

checklist.name: python language
checklist.description: Assigns language `python` to packages from requirements.txt (not `pip` or `py`)

checklist.name: Combined JSON array
checklist.description: All packages from all three manifests are combined into a single JSON array with `{language, name, version}` objects

checklist.name: Single check invocation
checklist.description: Passes the combined JSON array to `npx @meterian/cli check` in one command (not separate per-language commands)

checklist.name: Markdown table
checklist.description: Report contains a markdown table with the required audit columns (Package, Version, Severity, ID, Safe Versions)

checklist.name: Summary line
checklist.description: Report includes a summary line referencing total vulnerability count and package counts
